text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report advises on the feasibility of reducing the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Military Trail between Morningside Avenue and Old Kingston Road.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Military Trail, between Morningside Avenue and Old Kingston Road.
